answer: Require each agent to bond refundable collateral into a time-locked vault before it may transact; the settlement kernel weights a vote by stake-age, not by headcount. Peer attestations pass through a prism that splits one operator's reputation across every vault it funds, so spawning N sybils forces an attacker to lock N times the collateral and wait out N times the vesting. The cost of a fake crowd then scales linearly with real stake, not with cheap key generation.
